text: Saw this on the way to work.
Morning view from the room. We got here Thursday and leave on Monday. #travel

Made this again on Sunday. The dough sat in the fridge for two days, which is what the recipe said to do, and I think it did make a difference to the crust, though it is hard to say for certain since I changed the oven temperature at the same time. Next time I will only change one thing. Used the same tomatoes as last time. The basil was from the plant on the windowsill, which is still alive, somehow. Took about four hours from start to finish, most of that waiting. Would make it again. #homecooking #pizza
